scope: Coordination checkpoint, pause, cancellation and resume semantics only. No provider dispatch, scheduler/worker execution, provider retry, provider reconciliation, Book admission execution, canonical manuscript mutation, cache, context compilation or persistence-backend durability is implemented or claimed by this packet.
laws: Every pause, cancellation and resume operation binds to exact workflow, plan and immutable Book/manuscript source identity.
A checkpoint records references, hashes and coordination state only; raw manuscript or candidate text is forbidden.
Completed verified task state and previously recorded specialist/evaluator/evidence references are preserved across pause/resume and cancellation.
A paused workflow cannot claim a task is still actively RUNNING; pre-pause RUNNING tasks become interrupted coordination work pending resume classification.
Resume validates the checkpoint against the exact PAUSED workflow state and the current Book/manuscript source identity before changing coordination state.
If the Book/manuscript source identity changed while paused, the old workflow cannot resume; a new workflow identity is required.
Interrupted registered-idempotent provider work may become READY for later exact-same-operation replay only through Phase 2F identity semantics; this packet does not execute the replay.
Interrupted non-idempotent provider work, including PROSE.GENERATE_REVISION_CANDIDATE, is BLOCKED pending reconciliation and may not be regenerated automatically.
Interrupted author/required-authority waits remain blocked on that authority and cannot be synthesized.
Declared-but-unavailable specialist interfaces remain blocked and are never replaced with guessed providers on resume.

Book admission is never retried, resumed or executed as provider work. Workflows already in ADMISSION_PENDING cannot be paused or cancelled through this coordinator because canonical-effect outcome must first be resolved by Book authority.
Cancellation is terminal for the same workflow identity. A CANCELLED workflow is never resumed in place; later work requires a new workflow identity bound to current Book/manuscript state.
Cancellation preserves the original manuscript, verified completed work references and evidence, while non-completed task coordination state becomes CANCELLED.
Pause/resume/cancellation records never authorize canonical manuscript effect.
The orchestrator does not persist checkpoints durably in Phase 2H; Phase 5 must bind these records to durable workflow/job storage before crash-survival durability is claimed.
